paras: Looking for a cat back exhaust system that offers both performance and control? Look no further than the Xforce Varex cat back exhaust for the Toyota 86 ZN8 / Subaru BRZ ZD8. Made from high-quality 304 stainless steel, this system is designed to improve exhaust flow and provide an aggressive exhaust note. Plus, with the Varex muffler technology, you can easily switch between loud and quiet modes to suit your driving style with the included key fob remote. The system features a 2.5" diameter pipe and twin 2.25" outlets with dual 4.5" tips, making it a perfect fit for your Toyota 86 ZN8. Upgrade
